fish.name: Anchovy
fish.descEs: Pez costero común de cardumen. Con 10 Zanahorias o 5 Huevos de chum se garantiza la captura.
fish.descEn: Common coastal schooling fish. Guaranteed catch with 10 Carrots or 5 Eggs as chum.

fish.name: Horse Mackerel
fish.descEs: Pez rápido de nado ágil activo todo el año. Otorga 36% base de soltar fragmento de Starlight Tuna.
fish.descEn: Fast year-round fish. Grants 36% base chance to drop a Starlight Tuna map piece.

fish.name: Sea Bass
fish.descEs: Pez robusto de aguas templadas. Fuente de escamas de pescado en primavera y 3% de Crystal Shrimp.
fish.descEn: Hardy temperate fish. Spring source of Fish Flakes and 3% Crystal Shrimp map drop.

fish.name: Butterflyfish
fish.descEs: Pez tropical de colores vivos. Ingrediente clave para Fish Flakes en verano.
fish.descEn: Vibrant tropical reef beauty. Key ingredient for summer Fish Flake crafting.

fish.name: Clownfish
fish.descEs: Habitante de anémonas. Otorga un 2.5% base de soltar mapa de Twilight Anglerfish.
fish.descEn: Anemone dweller granting a 2.5% base chance to drop a Twilight Anglerfish map piece.

fish.name: Sea Horse
fish.descEs: Delicada criatura que nada erguida en praderas de algas durante verano.
fish.descEn: Delicate creature swimming upright among summer kelp and seagrass beds.

fish.name: Blowfish
fish.descEs: Especie invernal exclusiva. Requerido para recetas de Fish Flake en invierno.
fish.descEn: Winter exclusive species required for cold season Fish Flake recipes.

fish.name: Halibut
fish.descEs: Pez plano de fondo. En otoño e invierno otorga 2.5% de mapa de Starlight Tuna.
fish.descEn: Flat bottom dweller granting 2.5% Starlight Tuna map pieces in autumn and winter.

fish.name: Squid
fish.descEs: Cefalópodo ágil de aguas frías. Otorga 5% base de soltar mapa de Phantom Barracuda.
fish.descEn: Agile cold water cephalopod granting 5% base chance of Phantom Barracuda map drops.

fish.name: Muskellunge
fish.descEs: Depredador alargado y exclusivo de otoño. Requerido para Fish Flakes otoñales.
fish.descEn: Elongated autumn-exclusive predator needed for autumn Fish Flake production.

fish.name: Porgy
fish.descEs: Pez plateado clásico presente todo el año. Se usa en Fish Flakes de primavera.
fish.descEn: Silver coastal fish available year-round. Used for spring Fish Flakes.

fish.name: Red Snapper
fish.chum: Apple x3 o Honey x1 (Garantizado con Red Wiggler)
fish.descEs: Pez rojo gourmet de alto valor. Ingrediente universal obligatorio de Fish Stick.
fish.descEn: Prized culinary fish. Base ingredient required for all seasonal Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Tuna
fish.chum: Orange x3 o Wild Mushroom x1 (Garantizado)
fish.descEs: Poderoso velocista oceánico. Base obligatoria (x8) para craftear Fish Oil en cualquier estación.
fish.descEn: Powerful open water runner. Essential base ingredient (x8) for all seasonal Fish Oil recipes.

fish.name: Angelfish
fish.descEs: Elegante habitante de arrecife activo en verano e invierno. Requerido para Fish Sticks en invierno.
fish.descEn: Graceful reef swimmer active in summer and winter. Required for winter Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Moray Eel
fish.descEs: Anguiliforme voraz de grietas rocosas. Requerida para fabricar Fish Sticks de otoño.
fish.descEn: Ambush predator lurking in rocky crevices. Autumn ingredient for Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Parrotfish
fish.descEs: Pico triturador de corales. Otorga un impresionante 21% base de fragmento de Twilight Anglerfish.
fish.descEn: Coral grazer granting an outstanding 21% base chance of Twilight Anglerfish map pieces.

fish.name: Surgeonfish
fish.descEs: Armado con una espina caudal afilada. Requerido para Fish Sticks de verano.
fish.descEn: Armed with a razor spine. Required for summer seasonal Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Zebra Turkeyfish
fish.descEs: Espinas majestuosas pero venenosas. Requerido para Fish Sticks en primavera.
fish.descEn: Majestic venomous spines. Required for spring Fish Stick processing.

fish.name: Ray
fish.descEs: Criatura alada de fondo arenoso. Otorga una de las mayores recompensas de XP de rango avanzado.
fish.descEn: Flat sandy seabed glider offering top-tier XP yield among advanced fish.

fish.name: Tilapia
fish.descEs: Pez adaptable de agua cálida. Requerido para Fish Sticks de verano.
fish.descEn: Adaptable warm water species needed for summer Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Trout
fish.descEs: Habitante de corrientes rápidas. Otorga 2% base de soltar fragmento de Radiant Ray.
fish.descEn: Fast stream swimmer offering 2% base chance of Radiant Ray map piece drops.

fish.name: Olive Flounder
fish.descEs: Camuflado en la arena. Requerido para los Fish Sticks de primavera.
fish.descEn: Sand camouflage master required for spring seasonal Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Walleye
fish.descEs: Ojos reflectantes para aguas oscuras. Se utiliza en Fish Sticks de invierno.
fish.descEn: Reflective nocturnal eyes. Ingredient for winter seasonal Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Barred Knifejaw
fish.descEs: Mandíbula trituradora de conchas. Otorga 1% de fragmento de Deep Sea Slug.
fish.descEn: Crushing beak jaw granting 1% Deep Sea Slug map piece drops.

fish.name: Blue Marlin
fish.descEs: Acróbata veloz de alta mar. Requerido para Fish Oil en invierno.
fish.descEn: High seas acrobat required for winter seasonal Fish Oil processing.

fish.name: Football fish
fish.descEs: Pez abisal globular con señuelo. Requerido para Fish Oil en invierno.
fish.descEn: Abyssal angler with glowing bulb. Required for winter Fish Oil crafting.

fish.name: Hammerhead shark
fish.descEs: Cefalofoil electromagnético. Otorga 5% base de fragmento de Radiant Ray.
fish.descEn: Sensory apex predator granting 5% base drop chance for Radiant Ray map pieces.

fish.name: Saw Shark
fish.descEs: Hocico aserrado temible. Con 3 Speed Chicken de chum se garantiza la captura.
fish.descEn: Serrated predatory snout. 100% guaranteed catch using 3 Speed Chickens as chum.

fish.name: White Shark
fish.descEs: Rey del océano. Otorga un impresionante 30% base de fragmento de Gilded Swordfish.
fish.descEn: Apex oceanic titan granting a massive 30% base chance for Gilded Swordfish map pieces.

fish.name: Whale Shark
fish.descEs: Gigante gentil filtrador. Con 3 Fat Chicken como chum se garantiza su captura.
fish.descEn: Gentle plankton filterer. Guaranteed catch when chummed with 3 Fat Chickens.

fish.name: Coelacanth
fish.descEs: Fósil viviente de las profundidades. Otorga 0.5% de fragmento de Deep Sea Pig.
fish.descEn: Living prehistoric fossil offering 0.5% Deep Sea Pig map piece drops.

fish.name: Mahi Mahi
fish.descEs: Destello dorado y turquesa. Requerido en grandes cantidades (x4) para Fish Oil de otoño.
fish.descEn: Iridescent gamefish needed in large volume (x4) for autumn Fish Oil crafting.

fish.name: Oarfish
fish.descEs: Criatura mítica de gran longitud. Requerido para Fish Oil de primavera.
fish.descEn: Mythical elongated deep sea dweller required for spring Fish Oil recipes.

fish.name: Napoleanfish
fish.descEs: Giba frontal característica. Se utiliza para Fish Sticks de otoño.
fish.descEn: Humphead reef giant used for autumn seasonal Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Cobia
fish.descEs: Pez veloz con aspecto similar al tiburón. Se usa en Fish Oil de verano.
fish.descEn: Shark-like coastal swimmer used in summer seasonal Fish Oil recipes.

fish.name: Rock Blackfish
fish.descEs: Resistente a rompientes marinas. Otorga 5% base de fragmento de Gilded Swordfish.
fish.descEn: Rough swell dweller granting 5% base chance of Gilded Swordfish map drops.

fish.name: Weakfish
fish.descEs: Boca delicada en aguas costeras. Ingrediente de Fish Oil en primavera.
fish.descEn: Tender-mouthed coastal gamefish required for spring Fish Oil crafting.

fish.name: Sunfish
fish.descEs: Disco colosal de superficie estival. Otorga 0.5% de fragmento de Deep Sea Pig.
fish.descEn: Colossal summer disk basking at surface. Grants 0.5% Deep Sea Pig map drops.

fish.name: Starlight Tuna
fish.chum: 9x Map Pieces (Hasta 144% en Luna Llena + Helm)
fish.descEs: 1 de las 5 Maravillas Marinas oficiales. Se arma con 9 fragmentos obtenidos pescando Horse Mackerel (36%) o Halibut.
fish.descEn: 1 of the 5 official Marine Marvels. Assembled with 9 map pieces from Horse Mackerel (36%) or Halibut.

fish.name: Twilight Anglerfish
fish.chum: 9x Map Pieces (Hasta 84% en Luna Llena + Helm)
fish.descEs: 1 de las 5 Maravillas Marinas oficiales. Sus fragmentos se obtienen con Parrotfish (21%) o Clownfish (2.5%).
fish.descEn: 1 of the 5 official Marine Marvels. Map pieces collected via Parrotfish (21%) or Clownfish (2.5%).

fish.name: Gilded Swordfish
fish.descEs: 1 de las 5 Maravillas Marinas oficiales. Otorga +0.1 de Oro pasivo. Fragmentos con White Shark (30%) o Rock Blackfish (5%).
fish.descEn: 1 of the 5 official Marine Marvels granting +0.1 passive Gold. Maps from White Shark (30%) or Rock Blackfish (5%).

fish.name: Radiant Ray
fish.chum: 9x Map Pieces (Hasta 20% en Luna Llena + Helm)
fish.descEs: 1 de las 5 Maravillas Marinas oficiales. Brillo submarino místico con fragmentos de Hammerhead shark y Trout.
fish.descEn: 1 of the 5 official Marine Marvels. Luminous undersea treasure found via Hammerhead and Trout.

fish.name: Phantom Barracuda
fish.chum: 9x Map Pieces (Hasta 20% en Luna Llena + Helm)
fish.descEs: 1 de las 5 Maravillas Marinas oficiales. Se mueve como un espectro. Fragmentos obtenidos pescando Calamar y Mahi Mahi.
fish.descEn: 1 of the 5 official Marine Marvels striking like a ghost. Map pieces from Squid and Mahi Mahi.

fish.name: Dollocaris
fish.descEs: Mutante crustáceo jurásico de enormes ojos abisales recuperado de fosas submarinas.
fish.descEn: Prehistoric jurassic arthropod mutant with oversized compound eyes from deep abyss.

fish.name: Longhorn Cowfish
fish.descEs: Mutante de cornamenta acorazada. Otorga un bono pasivo de producción de +0.2 de Leche.
fish.descEn: Horned boxfish mutant granting a permanent +0.2 passive Milk farm bonus.

fish.name: Deep Sea Pig
fish.descEs: Mutante abisal translúcido que camina con patas tubulares. 0.5% de fragmento con Sunfish o Coelacanth.
fish.descEn: Translucent abyssal sea pig mutant. 0.5% map drop chance from Sunfish or Coelacanth.

fish.name: Deep Sea Slug
fish.descEs: Mutante nudibranquio de fuentes hidrotermales. Fragmentos soltados por Knifejaw (1%) y Surgeonfish (0.1%).
fish.descEn: Hydrothermal vent nudibranch mutant. Map piece drops from Knifejaw (1%) and Surgeonfish (0.1%).

fish.name: Crystal Shrimp
fish.descEs: Mutante camarón cristalino de exhibición mística. Soltado pescando Sea Bass (3%) o Tuna (0.8%).
fish.descEn: Glassy crystal shrimp mutant display relic. Dropped while catching Sea Bass (3%) or Tuna (0.8%).

fish.name: Nautilus
fish.descEs: Mutante ancestral de concha helicoidal y cámaras de flotabilidad hidrostática.
fish.descEn: Spiral shelled ancient cephalopod mutant with chambers for buoyant depth drift.

fish.name: Betta
fish.descEs: Pez mutante introducido en la Temporada 16 (Cave Dwellers). Habita en los estanques de agua subterránea de la Cueva.
fish.descEn: Season 16 (Cave Dwellers) mutant fish native to dark subterranean cave waters.

fish.name: Macropinna
fish.descEs: Pez de cabeza transparente y ojos tubulares abisales introducido en el Capítulo 16 (Cave Dwellers).
fish.descEn: Transparent domed barrel-eye cave mutant from Season 16 Cave Dwellers expansion.

fish.name: Manatee
fish.descEs: Coloso dulce y pacífico de caverna inundada. El mayor mutante acuático del Capítulo 16.
fish.descEn: Gentle giant mammal swimming through flooded caverns in Season 16 Cave Dwellers.

fish.name: Battle Fish
fish.descEs: Pez acorazado con espíritu guerrero codiciado en torneos y desafíos de pesca.
fish.descEn: Armored combat fish sought after during Bumpkin tournament fishing trials.

fish.name: Crimson Carp
fish.descEs: Carpa mutante de escamas rojo carmesí que habita en profundidades ricas en minerales.
fish.descEn: Radiant crimson scaled carp inhabiting mineral-rich deep currents.

fish.name: Giant Isopod
fish.descEs: Colosal crustáceo bentónico de aguas ultra profundas y exoesqueleto segmentado blindado.
fish.descEn: Colossal benthic crustacean from deepest trenches with heavy segmented armor.

fish.name: Jellyfish
fish.descEs: Medusa translúcida bioluminiscente que flota plácidamente en las mareas nocturnas.
fish.descEn: Translucent bioluminescent jellyfish glowing in the deep ocean night tides.

fish.name: Lemon Shark
fish.descEs: Tiburón cítrico de tonalidad dorada. Otorga un bono permanente de +0.2 de limón al cosechar.
fish.descEn: Citrus-toned shark granting a permanent +0.2 boost to Lemon tree harvesting.

fish.name: Pink Dolphin
fish.descEs: Criatura mística y legendaria de nado rosado perlado. Muy difícil de avistar en alta mar.
fish.descEn: Legendary and graceful pink dolphin navigating tropical swells.

fish.name: Poseidon
fish.descEs: Majestuoso pez legendario adornado como el soberano de las profundidades marinas.
fish.descEn: Regal mythological deep ruler fish cloaked in trident-like dorsal fins.

fish.name: Super Star
fish.descEs: Equinodermo pentagonal con un brillo celestial que ilumina el lecho marino.
fish.descEn: Radiant starburst echinoderm shimmering with celestial glow along seabed.

fish.name: Blue Crab
fish.chum: Heart Leaf x3 o Ribbon x3 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Cangrejo de pinzas zafiro. Se captura en Crab Pot (4h) con 3 Heart Leaf o 3 Ribbon.
fish.descEn: Sapphire clawed crustacean caught in 4-hour Crab Pots with 3 Heart Leaf or 3 Ribbon.

fish.name: Lobster
fish.chum: Wild Grass x3 o Frost Pebble x3 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Crustáceo bermellón gourmet. Captura garantizada en Crab Pot con 3 Wild Grass o 3 Frost Pebble.
fish.descEn: Gourmet crustacean reliably harvested from 4h Crab Pots with 3 Wild Grass or 3 Frost Pebble.

fish.name: Hermit Crab
fish.chum: Grape x5 o Rice x5 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Habitante de conchas marinas. Receta fija en Crab Pot cebado con 5 Uvas o 5 Arroz.
fish.descEn: Shell-dwelling crab. Guaranteed in 4h Crab Pots using 5 Grapes or 5 Rice.

fish.name: Shrimp
fish.descEs: Camarón costero de muelle. Se obtiene al cebar un Crab Pot de 4 horas con 2 Crimstone.
fish.descEn: Coastal shrimp harvested from 4h Crab Pots primed with 2 Crimstone.

fish.name: Mussel
fish.descEs: Molusco bivalvo azulado oscuro. Receta exclusiva de Crab Pot con 1 Moonfur.
fish.descEn: Dark blue bivalve mollusc. Exclusive 4h Crab Pot recipe requiring 1 Moonfur.

fish.name: Oyster
fish.descEs: Ostra perlífera de roca. Captura garantizada en Crab Pot cebado con 2 Fish Stick.
fish.descEn: Reef oyster harvested from 4h Crab Pots chummed with 2 Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Anemone
fish.chum: Fish Oil x2 o Crab Stick x2 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Pólipo marino de tentáculos ondulantes. Se atrapa con 2 Fish Oil o 2 Crab Stick en Crab Pot.
fish.descEn: Tentacled marine polyp collected in Crab Pots baited with 2 Fish Oil or 2 Crab Sticks.

fish.name: Isopod
fish.descEs: Crustáceo acorazado de fondo. Es la captura estándar garantizada en Crab Pot al no poner ningún chum.
fish.descEn: Armored bottom feeder. Default guaranteed harvest from 4h Crab Pots with no chum.

fish.name: Sea Slug
fish.descEs: Babosa marina de arrecife profundo. Se recolecta en Mariner Pot (8h) cebada con 2 Crimstone.
fish.descEn: Deep reef nudibranch slug. Harvested in 8h Mariner Pots primed with 2 Crimstone.

fish.name: Sea Snail
fish.chum: Chewed Bone x3 o Ruffroot x3 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Gasterópodo acorazado con concha espiral. Receta de Mariner Pot (8h) con 3 Chewed Bone o 3 Ruffroot.
fish.descEn: Spiral shelled gastropod caught in 8h Mariner Pots with 3 Chewed Bones or 3 Ruffroot.

fish.name: Garden Eel
fish.chum: Dewberry x3 o Duskberry x3 (Receta Exacta)
fish.descEs: Anguila que asoma de la arena. Obtenida en Mariner Pot (8h) cebada con 3 Dewberry o 3 Duskberry.
fish.descEn: Sand burrowing eel secured in 8h Mariner Pots with 3 Dewberry or 3 Duskberry.

fish.name: Sea Grapes
fish.descEs: Alga esférica de textura perlada. Cosechada en Mariner Pot (8h) cebada con 3 Lunara.
fish.descEn: Pearlescent green macroalgae harvested from 8h Mariner Pots with 3 Lunara.

fish.name: Octopus
fish.descEs: Cefalópodo inteligente de ocho brazos. Captura garantizada en Mariner Pot (8h) con 1 Moonfur.
fish.descEn: Intelligent eight-armed cephalopod caught in 8h Mariner Pots primed with 1 Moonfur.

fish.name: Sea Urchin
fish.descEs: Equinodermo esférico cubierto de púas. Se recolecta en Mariner Pot (8h) con 2 Fish Stick.
fish.descEn: Spiny spherical echinoderm harvested in 8h Mariner Pots with 2 Fish Sticks.

fish.name: Horseshoe Crab
fish.descEs: Quelicerado fósil viviente de caparazón curvo. Receta fija en Mariner Pot (8h) con 2 Crab Stick.
fish.descEn: Living fossil chelicerate harvested in 8h Mariner Pots primed with 2 Crab Sticks.

fish.name: Barnacle
fish.descEs: Crustáceo sésil adherido a pilotes y rocas. Es la captura estándar garantizada de Mariner Pot sin chum.
fish.descEn: Sessile rock crustacean. Default guaranteed harvest from 8h Mariner Pots with no chum.
